sources.use_basis: Limited-domain working record: 30 wt% MEA on unloaded-solvent basis, 313.15–353.15 K (40–80 °C). 142 fitted targets: 48 pressure + 94 species (40 Böttinger + 54 Matin). Matin 18 HCO3− + CO3²− pool targets report-only; measurement 21 °C, packet 20 °C. SSM+DS narrow 4.6% local optimum advantage over Original Born; HCO3−–water k=+0.5 upper bound, no global optimum or uncertainty band. Poor 15/45 wt% transfer; carbonate comparison only retained nine points; 100–120 °C outside working qualification. R4 source range 293.15–323.15 K; inherited reaction-source extrapolation. No independent physical validation, caloric or process-column qualification. Two unavailable Born probe solves have undetermined cause under Engine investigation. Inherited pressure bounds are computational, not physically qualified. Historical 160-target SSM+DS: six attempted starts, five converged, one initial evaluation failed. 142-target P5 warm continuation: one further update, function tolerance 1e-12 relative, zero trial failures; not six independent starts. f66d972c S1 remains ancestry.
